719-1309-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
719-1309-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Xenograft, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Salvager of Secrets token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2085-2645-3430-6256.easyPrerequisites: Kelpie Guide doesn't have summoning sickness.
2085-2645-3430-6256.description:
Activate Muraganda Raceway by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, untapping Muraganda Raceway
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

147-653-2438.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-653-2438.description:
Cast Fearsome Awakening by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Fearsome Awakening.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Fearsome Awakening
Resolve the Fearsome Awakening copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

443-728-2158-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
443-728-2158-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Magus of the Bridge triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1170-1477-4985-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1477-4985-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Jhoira's Familiar.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature
Repeat.

277-5900-7894.easyPrerequisites: You control up to three lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {1}{G}{U}.
277-5900-7894.description:
Activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}{U}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Gandalf.
When Gandalf enters, its first ability triggers, blinking the lands tapped for mana in step 1.
When the lands enter, Tiller Engine and Gandalf's second ability each trigger three times.
Resolve all Tiller Engine triggers, untapping the lands that entered.
Resolve all Gandalf triggers, causing you to draw three cards and put three +1/+1 counters on Gandalf.
Repeat.

3263-5412-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
3263-5412-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter as an artifact land creature due to Mycosynth Lattice and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 2 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Coastal Hornclaw.

1003-1591-1778-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1003-1591-1778-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

618-3375-4456-7494.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying {1}{R} due to The Immortal Sun.
Hematite Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2648-4050-4853-7452.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Phyrexian Triniform, adding {B}.
When Phyrexian Triniform dies, it and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Phyrexian Triniform trigger, creating three creature tokens.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Essence.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {1}{G}.
When the creatures die, Dross Scorpion triggers twice, untapping two artifacts.
Activate Cauldron of Essence by paying {1}{B}{G}, tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, and Dross Scorpion triggers if the creature was an artifact.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, if applicable, untapping an artifact.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence ability from step 7, returning Phyrexian Triniform from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1052-2511-3175.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

339-677-2438-4460.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3967-4681-5170-6794.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1003-4053-6798-6989.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

2034-5220-5243--53.easyPrerequisites: The Reality Chip attached to a creature you control.
2034-5220-5243--53.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature that can be cast using {C}{C}, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
2034-5220-5243--53.notes: If the creature can be cast using {C} or less, the combo nets infinite colorless mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Wight of the Reliquary

2178-5627-6528.easyPrerequisites: Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
2178-5627-6528.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2178-5627-6528.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Wight of the Reliquary triggers, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Resolve the Wight of the Reliquary ability from step 1, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Elfsworn Giant triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1445-4871-5632-5686.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-5632-5686.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Chalk Outline triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1309-1987-2493-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1309-1987-2493-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Archaeomancer and Salvager of Secrets.
When Archaeomancer and Salvager of Secrets enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1309-1987-2493-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

222-527-2438-3480.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-2438-3480.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2082-3197-5686.easyPrerequisites: Sadistic Glee attached to Herd Baloth.
2082-3197-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2082-3197-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies, Sadisitc Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

348-1580-2178-5477.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Priest of Forgotten Gods.
Priest of Forgotten Gods does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
348-1580-2178-5477.description:
Activate Priest of Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton and any other creature.
When Reassembling Skeleton and the other creature die, Priest of Forgotten Gods triggers twice, untapping Priest of Forgotten Gods.
Resolve the Priest of Forgotten Gods ability from step 1, causing any number of players to lose 2 life and sacrifice a creature, and you to add {B}{B} and draw a card.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Repeat.

uses.n: Disciple of Freyalise // Garden of Freyalise

648-5656.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token, and then putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your deck size.
Cast Disciple of Freyalise by paying {3}{G}{G}{G}.
When Disciple of Freyalise enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Fractal token, draw your library, and gain life equal to the amount of cards drawn this way.

232-618-1283-3525.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask token enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {3}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

190-1211-5172.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Skyship Weatherlight and creating a token copy of it under each other player's control.
Each new Skyship Weatherlight triggers, allowing you to control each opponent in turn and exile every artifact and creature card in their libraries.
You may play those cards for as long as they remain exiled.

4499-4802-4929.notablePrerequisites: Master Biomancer has a power of at least three.
4499-4802-4929.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Cryptic Trilobite.
Cryptic Trilobite enters the battlefield with at least three +1/+1 counters due to Master Biomancer.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

776-2825-5195.notablePrerequisites:
Any instant card with mana value 1 or less exiled by Elite Arcanist.
Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
776-2825-5195.description:
Activate Elite Arcanist by paying {1} and tapping it, copying the exiled instant card and casting the copy without paying its mana cost.
Jeskai Ascendancy's first and second abilities trigger, as well as Storm-Kiln Artist.
Resolve the first Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, giving creatures you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve the second Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, allowing you to loot.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the copy of the instant spell created in step 1.
Repeat.

1173-2160-3976.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1173-2160-3976.description:
Cast Final Fortune by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Final Fortune and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
During your next turn, deal combat damage to an opponent using the face down creature that has Final Fortune noted.
The creature triggers, casting a copy of Final Fortune without paying its mana cost. Resolve the copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Activate Sundial of the Infinite by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to end the turn. This will prevent the Final Fortune trigger from causing you to lose the game.
Repeat from step 3.

215-2059-4191.notablePrerequisites: You control creatures that can produce at least {2}{G}.
215-2059-4191.description:
Cast Village Bell-Ringer.
Untap all creatures on ETB trigger.
Pay {1}{G} to Temur Sabertooth to return the Village Bell-Ringer to your hand.
Tap remaining creatures for mana.
Repeat.

539-630-1247.notablePrerequisites: Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
539-630-1247.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
